title: Windows Update Repair
description: Diagnose Windows Update failures with service, log, component-store, and policy evidence before staged approved repairs.
starter_prompt: Diagnose and repair Windows Update. Start with read-only checks and verify with an update scan.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dism=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\Dism.exe'; $netsh=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\netsh.exe'; foreach($exe in @($dism,$netsh)){ if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows tool not found: ' + $exe) } }; Write-Output '== Update services =='; Get-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,trustedinstaller | Format-Table Name,Status,StartType -AutoSize; Write-Output '== Pending reboot markers =='; $paths='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired','HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager'; foreach ($p in $paths) { Write-Output $p; Test-Path $p }; Write-Output '== Update history =='; Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output '== Windows Update events =='; try { Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-30)} -MaxEvents 120 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message | Format-List } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] Windows Update events unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== DISM CheckHealth =='; & $dism /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth; Write-Output ('DISM CheckHealth exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '== Proxy =='; & $netsh winhttp show proxy; Write-Output ('netsh winhttp show proxy exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE)

phases.prompt: Collect read-only Windows Update services, pending reboot state, update history, event logs, DISM CheckHealth, and proxy clues.
Analyze collected Windows Update services, pending reboot state, update history, WindowsUpdateClient events, CBS/DISM signals, network/proxy clues, and exact error code.
Propose staged repair from least-risk to higher-risk. Do not reset components or run DISM repair without overseer lease.
phases.completion: Repair plan has steps, risk, rollback, and verification.

phases.prompt: Ask human or apply access-mode policy before system-changing repair. Offer restore point when needed.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dism=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\Dism.exe'; $sfc=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\sfc.exe'; foreach($exe in @($dism,$sfc)){ if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows repair tool not found: ' + $exe) } }; $failures=@(); Write-Output '== Windows Update services before repair =='; Get-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,trustedinstaller | Format-Table Name,Status,StartType -AutoSize; Write-Output '== DISM ScanHealth =='; & $dism /Online /Cleanup-Image /ScanHealth; $scanExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('DISM ScanHealth exit code: ' + $scanExit); if($scanExit -ne 0 -and $scanExit -ne 3010){ $failures+=('DISM ScanHealth exit ' + $scanExit) }; Write-Output '== DISM RestoreHealth =='; & $dism /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth; $restoreExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('DISM RestoreHealth exit code: ' + $restoreExit); if($restoreExit -ne 0 -and $restoreExit -ne 3010){ $failures+=('DISM RestoreHealth exit ' + $restoreExit) }; Write-Output '== SFC scan =='; & $sfc /scannow; $sfcExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('sfc /scannow exit code: ' + $sfcExit); if($sfcExit -ne 0){ $failures+=('sfc /scannow exit ' + $sfcExit) }; Write-Output '== Ensure update services running =='; foreach($service in @('bits','wuauserv','cryptsvc')){ try { Start-Service -Name $service -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('started=' + $service) } catch { $failures+=('Start-Service ' + $service + ' failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }; Get-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,trustedinstaller | Format-Table Name,Status,StartType -AutoSize; if($failures.Count -gt 0){ throw ('Windows Update repair steps failed: ' + ($failures -join '; ')) }; Write-Output 'Repair commands finished. Reboot may be required before update scan verification.'

phases.prompt: Execute only approved Windows Update repair steps and capture full output. Fail the phase when any repair step reports a non-zero exit code.
phases.completion: Every repair step reported success, or the phase failed with the exact failing step and exit code.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dism=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\Dism.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dism -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows tool not found: ' + $dism) }; Write-Output '== Update services after repair =='; Get-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,trustedinstaller | Format-Table Name,Status,StartType -AutoSize; Write-Output '== DISM CheckHealth after repair =='; & $dism /Online /Cleanup-Image /CheckHealth; Write-Output ('DISM CheckHealth exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Write-Output '== Pending reboot markers =='; $paths='HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WindowsUpdate\Auto Update\RebootRequired','HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager'; foreach ($p in $paths) { Write-Output $p; Test-Path $p }; Write-Output '== Windows Update scan =='; $scanOk=$false; try { $session=New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session; $searcher=$session.CreateUpdateSearcher(); $searchResult=$searcher.Search('IsInstalled=0 and IsHidden=0'); Write-Output ('Update search result code: ' + $searchResult.ResultCode); Write-Output ('Updates available: ' + $searchResult.Updates.Count); $searchResult.Updates | Select-Object -First 20 Title | Format-List; $scanOk=($searchResult.ResultCode -eq 2) } catch { Write-Output ('[error] Windows Update scan failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== Recent Windows Update events =='; try { Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-WindowsUpdateClient'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-2)} -MaxEvents 60 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,LevelDisplayName,Message | Format-List } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] Recent Windows Update events unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; Write-Output '== Recent hotfixes =='; Get-HotFix | Sort-Object InstalledOn -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 HotFixID,Description,InstalledOn | Format-Table -AutoSize; if(-not $scanOk){ throw 'Windows Update scan did not complete, so the original update failure is not verified as repaired' }

phases.prompt: Verify component health, update service state, pending reboot state, a real Windows Update scan, and recent update events after approved repair.
phases.completion: A Windows Update scan completed and the original symptom is verified, or the remaining error is captured and the phase fails.

phases.prompt: Check whether repair matched evidence and whether verification is sufficient.
phases.completion: Review passes or gaps are listed.

phases.prompt: Create a technician-readable Windows Update repair report with evidence, repair actions/tools used, command output, verification result, logs/artifacts, cleanup status, residual risk, reboot needs, and follow-up.
Preserve CBS/DISM/update logs, command output, and reports; remove only temporary scratch files created by this workflow.

acceptance_criteria: Read-only evidence was collected before repair.
Restore-point prompt occurred before risky repair.
Final answer includes verification result and remaining risk.
